defs.def: to travel to or around an area or a country in order to learn about it 勘探；勘查；探索；考察

ex.s: Bordering the square, the Ludlow Castle is a “must explore” medieval stronghold.
ex.t: 城堡Ludlow紧邻广场，是一座“必探”的中世纪要塞。

ex.s: ·Agricultural Science: Introducing you to areas such as biology, urban farming, and environmental science so that you can explore the field of agriculture
ex.t: ·农业科学：向您介绍生物学、城市农业和环境科学等领域，以便您能探索农业领域

ex.s: ·Science Lab: Leading you to explore the skills you need to succeed in life in key areas like computer science, robotics, and physics
ex.t: 科学实验室：引导你在计算机科学、机器人技术和物理等关键领域探索成功生活所需技能。

ex.s: Inspired by magical maps in her stories, she wondered: what if we could build a real-world app that helps people explore hidden places in their own cities?
ex.t: 受故事中神奇地图的启发，她想：如果我们能做一个现实世界的应用，帮助人们在自己城市里探索隐藏的地点，会怎样？

ex.s: continue exploring the classical models in history
ex.t: 继续探索历史上的经典模型

ex.s: Cycling is the most economical, sustainable and fun way to explore the city, with its beautiful canals, parks, squares and countless lights.
ex.t: 骑自行车是最经济、可持续且有趣的城市探索方式，这里有美丽的运河、公园、广场和无数的灯光。

ex.s: When John Todd was a child he loved to explore the woods around his house, observing how nature solved problems.
ex.t: 当约翰·托德还是个孩子的时候，他喜欢探索房子周围的树林，观察大自然如何解决问题。

ex.s: You can also make appointments to meet with a career coach, access career resources, and explore careers that interest you.
ex.t: 你还可以预约与职业教练见面、获取职业资源，并探索你感兴趣的职业。

ex.s: People develop countless habits as they explore the world, whether they are aware of them or not.
ex.t: 人们在探索世界的过程中养成无数的习惯，无论他们是否意识到这一点。

ex.s: Exploring the place alone.
ex.t: 独自探索这个地方。

ex.s: After our third run Andrew shut down the engine, and we went our separate ways — he for a lunch break, I to explore the city.
ex.t: 第三趟航行结束后Andrew关掉发动机，我们各奔东西——他去吃午饭，我去探索这座城市。

ex.s: She moved their family from Canada to California when she was one year old, because he wanted them to explore a new place together.
ex.t: 在她一岁时，她把全家从加拿大搬到了加利福尼亚，因为他想让他们一起探索一个新地方。

ex.s: She's healthy, strong and already eager to play and explore.
ex.t: 她身体健康，强壮，已经渴望玩耍和探索。

ex.s: They enjoyed exploring new places
ex.t: 她们喜欢探索新地方

ex.s: But we want to go beyond one man and explore the nature of genius itself.
ex.t: 但我们想超越某一个人，去探索天才本身的本质。

ex.s: The first step is to go exploring
ex.t: 要准备好和陌生人进行尴尬的对话

ex.s: The universe is all yours to explore and enjoy.
ex.t: 宇宙完全属于你去探索和享受。

ex.s: Discover, explore and enjoy award-winning Tullie House, where historic collections, contemporary art and family fun are brought together in one impressive museum and art gallery.
ex.t: 探索、欣赏Tullie House这个获奖场所，这里将历史收藏、当代艺术和家庭乐趣汇集在一个令人印象深刻的博物馆和美术馆中。

ex.s: Take a tour of his Lakeland cottage, walk through his hillside garden and explore the riches of the collection in the Museum.
ex.t: 参观他在湖区的村舍，漫步他的山坡花园，并探索博物馆藏品的丰富宝藏。

ex.s: Where should visitors go if they want to explore Wordsworth’s life?
ex.t: 如果游客想探索华兹华斯的生活，他们应该去哪里？

ex.s: As we travel south from Madrid with Prof Ronald Messier to historic Toledo，Roman Merida and into Andalucia, we explore historical monuments and architecture.
ex.t: 当我们从马德里向南旅行，由Ronald Messier教授带领前往历史名城托莱多、罗马城市梅里达并进入安达卢西亚地区时，我们将探索历史古迹和建筑。

ex.s: Greatness comes from a lasting desire to explore.
ex.t: 伟大来自持久的探索欲望。

ex.s: To further explore historical mysteries．
ex.t: 下午7:00 颁奖典礼和野餐

ex.s: explore a fantasy land
ex.t: A．探索奇幻之地

ex.s: Want to explore new cultures，meet new people and do something worthwhile at the same time?
ex.t: 想探索新文化、结识新朋友，同时做点有意义的事吗？

ex.s: explore new cultures      B. protect the environment
ex.t: 探索新文化 B. 保护环境

ex.s: （1分）The                 that there is life on other planets in the universe has always inspired scientists to explore the outer space．（  ）
ex.t: 6．（1分）宇宙中其他行星上存在生命这一______一直激励着科学家探索外太空。（ ）

ex.s: eager to explore the world around them
ex.t: B．停止总是抱怨。

ex.s: When I was a little girl， my family moved to a tiny town at the bottom of a big mountain． One day after school， while exploring the green woods of this magnificent mountain， I almost fell on a set of stairs． What could these steps lead to？ Curiosity got the best of me as I knew it would be starting to get dark soon． I started climbing up those strangely mysterious steps．
ex.t: 当我还是个小女孩时，我家搬到了一座大山脚下的一个小镇。一天放学后，在探索这座壮丽山峰的翠绿树林时，我差点踩到一段楼梯。这些台阶通向哪里呢？好奇心占了上风，尽管我知道天很快就要黑了。我开始爬上那些神秘莫测的台阶。

ex.s: While high school does not generally encourage students to explore new aspects of life, college sets the stage for that exploration.
ex.t: 虽然高中通常不鼓励学生探索生活的新方面，但大学为这种探索搭建了舞台。

ex.s: To explore newmeans of transport.
ex.t: 探索交通新意。

ex.s: The campus was still quiet when I arrived, so I decided to explore a bit.
ex.t: 我到达时校园还很安静，于是我决定四处转转。

ex.s: You can explore the Great Barrier Reef by visiting an underwater observatory.
ex.t: 你可以通过参观水下观测站来探索大堡礁。

ex.s: With his limitless imagination, he created new worlds for his readers to explore.
ex.t: 凭借无限的想象力，他为读者创造了可供探索的新世界。

ex.s: Put on your hiking boots and explore islands with waterfalls and active volcanoes.
ex.t: 穿上你的登山靴，去探索有瀑布和活火山的岛屿。

ex.s: In your free time, you can explore the city, have language classes, surf or choose your favourite from among the following.
ex.t: 在空闲时间，你可以探索城市、上语言课、冲浪，或从以下选项中挑选你最喜欢的。

ex.s: Explore the monuments and memorials on the National Mall as your guide shares unique facts and history at each stop.
ex.t: 当导游在每一站分享独特的事实和历史时，探索国家广场上的纪念碑和纪念物。

ex.s: However, if you are unsure what track you want, you still get to explore any workshop you want as part of our Explore Workshops.
ex.t: 然而，如果你不确定想走哪条轨道，你仍然可以作为我们探索工作坊的一部分，去探索任何你想去的工作坊。

defs.def: to examine sth completely or carefully in order to find out more about it 探究；调查研究；探索；探讨

ex.s: Some of your interests may not appear to be connected but, once you explore their depths, you discover that they are.
ex.t: 你的一些兴趣可能看起来互不相干，但一旦你探究它们的深度，就会发现它们是相关的。

ex.s: In my defence, I did what we’ve all done before, which is to repeat received wisdom without exploring the nuances.
ex.t: 为我自己辩护一下，我做了我们所有人都做过的事，那就是在不探究细节的情况下重复人云亦云的观点。

ex.s: It's still a little too cold for them to go out into the open, but as soon as the weather warms up, I have no doubt that the little one will be out and about exploring and playing every day.”
ex.t: 天气对他们来说还是有点太冷，不能到开阔地去，但等天气一暖和，我毫不怀疑这个小家伙就会整天在外面探索和玩耍。”

ex.s: The team’s data only went up to 2007, but the researchers also explored what would happen if consumers replaced old products with new electronics that serve more than one function, such as a tablet for word processing and TV viewing.
ex.t: 团队的数据只统计到2007年，但研究人员还探讨了如果消费者用具有多种功能的新电子产品替代旧产品会发生什么，例如用于文字处理和看电视的平板电脑。

ex.s: The movie explores the theme of responsibility in an intelligent and humorous way.
ex.t: 这部电影以一种聪明而幽默的方式探讨了责任的主题。

defs.def: to feel sth with your hands or another part of the body （用手或另一身体部位）触摸，探查

chunks.cn: 勘探 与 享受 … 的乐趣
勘探 刚出现的 文化
